adeptasororitas/rules/army_rules/Acts of:
Restriction: Army Faction ADEPTA SORORITAS
Unit from your army with this ability: 1 Act of Faith per phase, made with Miracle dice

Miracle dice gained, 1 each time:
- start of each turn
- an ADEPTA SORORITAS unit from your army is destroyed
Each Miracle dice gained: roll 1D6, result is its value
Value cannot be changed or re-rolled, unless a rule states otherwise
Miracle dice kept aside: Miracle dice pool

Before a dice roll for a model or unit from your army with Acts of Faith, if the Miracle dice pool holds a dice: that unit may perform an Act of Faith
If it does: select a dice from the pool to substitute that roll
Roll with more than 1 dice (Charge roll, Battle-shock test): only 1 dice substituted
Substituted dice not rolled; selected Miracle dice's value used as if rolled (counts as an unmodified roll of that value for all rules purposes)
Each Miracle dice selectable for substitution once
After all substitutions: chosen Miracle dice removed from the pool, all other unsubstituted dice in that roll rolled
Act of Faith usable for:
- Advance roll
- Battle-shock test
- Charge roll
- Damage roll
- Hit roll
- saving throw
- Wound roll
